title: 油价拖累通胀：核心CPI却稳，8月回升？
speaker: Jing Liu

segments.en: I think it's more or less expected it for this one in particular I think the deceleration is almost entirely attributable to the deceleration in the oil prices that's a good thing okay okay
segments.zh: 我认为这基本符合预期。此次通胀放缓几乎完全归因于油价下跌，这是好事。

segments.en: yeah I guess on top of that I think what's probably more interesting to look at is that if we look at the core CPI that one is more or less stable if we look at the months on months change again the biggest drag comes from the oil prices but the good thing is that we see
segments.zh: 更重要的是，核心CPI基本稳定。环比来看，最大拖累仍是油价，但好消息是……

segments.en: their style of stabilization on pork prices and altogether the food prices seem stable and other thing I want to point out is that in China actually there's a pricing mechanism NDRC adjusts the few prices with certain interval so from that perspective probably the volatility in July is not entirely
segments.zh: 猪肉价格趋于稳定，食品价格总体平稳。另外，中国有定价机制，发改委定期调整价格，因此7月的波动可能未完全体现。

segments.en: captured which means in August we might see the inflation up again again driven by the volatile oil prices because that is a delayed function is what you're saying in as far as the NDRC the cadence is not it's not a daily frequency daily update right every ten days they fix prices yeah understood now
segments.zh: 因此8月通胀可能因油价波动而回升，因为这是滞后效应。发改委每十天调整一次价格，而非每日更新。

segments.en: you have a macro tracker put everything together first how do you think the economy is doing
segments.zh: 您有一个宏观追踪指标，综合来看，您认为当前经济表现如何？
